top_signals.title: Malaysia’s Government Will Likely Serve Full Term: Anwar Adviser
top_signals.summary: Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim’s government is likely to serve until the end of its term despite recent speculation over an early election, according to his senior political adviser Zafrul Aziz.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
